info.title: JustRouting API
info.description: OSRM-compatible routing services (route, table, match, trip, nearest) and a hosted VROOM vehicle routing solver (optimize). All requests require a Bearer API key. Coordinates use `lng,lat` order and must be within a single country (Southeast Asia).

tags.name: nearest
tags.description: Snap a coordinate to the road network

get.summary: Find the fastest route between coordinates in order

metadata.title: route
metadata.description: Find the fastest route between coordinates in order

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Vehicle profile. `driving` for cars, `motorcycle` for motorcycles.

parameters.name: coordinates
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated `{lng},{lat}` pairs, up to 100, visited in order. All coordinates must be in the same country.

get.summary: Compute durations/distances between all pairs of coordinates

metadata.title: table
metadata.description: Compute durations/distances between all pairs of coordinates

parameters.name: coordinates
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated `{lng},{lat}` pairs, all in the same country.

parameters.name: fallback_speed
parameters.description: For unreachable pairs, estimate duration from crow-fly distance at this speed (km/h equivalent meters per second ratio).

parameters.name: scale_factor
parameters.description: Scale all durations by this factor.

get.summary: Snap a GPS trace to the road network

metadata.title: match
metadata.description: Snap a GPS trace to the road network

parameters.name: timestamps
parameters.description: UNIX timestamps (seconds) for each point, monotonically increasing, one per coordinate.

parameters.name: radiuses
parameters.description: GPS accuracy in meters per point (standard deviation). Use device-reported accuracy when available.

parameters.name: gaps
parameters.description: Whether large timestamp gaps split the trace into multiple matchings.

parameters.name: tidy
parameters.description: Allow removing noisy points to improve matching quality.

get.summary: Solve the traveling salesman problem for the given coordinates

metadata.title: trip
metadata.description: Solve the traveling salesman problem for the given coordinates

get.summary: Snap a single coordinate to the nearest routable segments

metadata.title: nearest
metadata.description: Snap a single coordinate to the nearest routable segments

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Number of nearest segments to return.

400.description: Invalid input (code 2) — details in the `error` field

bearerAuth.description: API key created in the JustRouting dashboard.

Overview.name: overview
Overview.description: How much route geometry to return.

Alternatives.name: alternatives
Alternatives.description: `true` for one alternative, or a number for up to that many (not guaranteed).

Annotations.name: annotations
Annotations.description: Per-coordinate metadata: `true`, or a comma list of `distance`, `duration`, `speed`, `weight`, `nodes`, `datasources`.

ContinueStraight.name: continue_straight
ContinueStraight.description: Force straight continuation at waypoints, constraining U-turns.

Radiuses.name: radiuses
Radiuses.description: Snapping radius in meters per coordinate, or `unlimited`.

Hints.name: hints
Hints.description: Base64 hints from a previous response to speed up snapping.

Exclude.name: exclude
Exclude.description: Road classes to avoid (additive list), e.g. `motorway`.

Approaches.name: approaches
Approaches.description: Restrict the road direction at each waypoint: `curb` / `opposite` / `unrestricted` (default), e.g. `curb;opposite`.

Snapping.name: snapping
Snapping.description: `default` avoids edges that cannot be used as start/end points; `any` snaps to any edge in the graph.

GenerateHints.name: generate_hints
GenerateHints.description: Add a `hint` to response waypoints for reuse in later requests.

SkipWaypoints.name: skip_waypoints
SkipWaypoints.description: Remove waypoints from the response (still calculated, not serialized).

Waypoints.name: waypoints
Waypoints.description: Indices of input coordinates to treat as waypoints in the response, e.g. `0;3`. Default is all input coordinates.

name.description: Street name the coordinate snapped to.

hint.description: Opaque segment identifier, reusable as the `hints` parameter.

nodes.description: OSM node ids of the segment.

type.description: turn, new name, depart, arrive, merge, on ramp, off ramp, fork, end of road, continue, roundabout, rotary, roundabout turn, notification, exit roundabout, exit rotary

exit.description: Number of the roundabout/rotary exit to take; absent when the destination is on the roundabout.

indications.description: Markings for the lane; a lane can have several.

valid.description: Whether the lane is a valid choice in the current maneuver.

bearings.description: Bearings of all roads at the intersection, 0-359 (0 = true north).

classes.description: Road classes of the exiting roads.

entry.description: Flags 1:1 with bearings; true means the road can be entered on a valid route.

in.description: Index into bearings of the road you came from; absent for depart.

out.description: Index into bearings of the road you take; absent for arrive.

lanes.description: Available turn lanes; absent when there is no lane data.

pronunciation.description: IPA phonetic transcription of the name.

exits.description: Exit numbers or names of the way.

data_version.description: Timestamp of the OSM data used.

durations.description: Row-major matrix of durations in seconds; null entries mean unreachable.

distances.description: Row-major matrix of distances in meters.

tracepoints.description: One entry per input point; null for dropped outliers.

vehicles.description: Available vehicles. Free plan: up to 10; Hobby: up to 50.

jobs.description: Tasks to serve. Free plan: up to 100; Hobby: up to 1,000.

matrices.description: Optional custom travel-time matrices per profile; skips OSRM table calls.

geometry.description: Add polyline geometry to each route in the response.

end.description: Return depot as `[lng, lat]`; same as start for a round trip; omit to stop at the last task.

skills.description: Job skills must be a subset of vehicle skills.

type.description: Vehicle type, referenced by per-type service times.

speed_factor.description: Scales all travel times for this vehicle.

steps.description: Custom route in plan mode, or search warm start in solving mode.

delivery.description: Amounts to deliver (loaded at vehicle start).

pickup.description: Amounts to pick up (returned at vehicle end).

priority.description: Higher priority tasks are preferred when not all tasks fit.

TimeWindow.description: `[start, end]` in seconds relative to the planning horizon, or absolute UNIX timestamps (consistent within one request).

CustomMatrices.description: Per-profile custom matrices. Providing durations for all profiles makes task locations optional.

code.description: 0 = ok, 1 = internal error, 2 = input error, 3 = routing error.
